settings.legal-body:
PrismHub is an open-source client. It does NOT host, store or distribute any content: it only displays what third-party extensions return from public websites, just as a browser would. Neither the project nor its authors are affiliated with those sites or control what they publish.

Users are solely responsible for how they use this software and for complying with the laws of their country, including copyright law. If content is protected and you have no right to access it, do not do so.

Content marked +18 is intended exclusively for adults as defined by their jurisdiction. It ships disabled and requires deliberate activation plus confirmation of legal age.

If you are a rights holder and believe an extension in the catalog links to infringing material, get in touch through the project repository on GitHub and that extension will be removed from the catalog.

This software is provided AS IS, without warranty of any kind, under AGPL-3.0.
settings.feedback-subtitle: PrismHub is in beta. Report any bugs you find or suggest improvements: they get reviewed and fixed in later versions.
settings.link-source-subtitle: The PrismHub repository on GitHub, licensed under AGPL-3.0.
settings.link-extensions-subtitle: prism-plus, the official catalog extensions are downloaded from.
settings.general-subtitle-android: Language, theme, +18 Zone access and PIN, TMDB key and update checks
settings.check-new-episodes-subtitle: Checks every 12 hours whether anything new came out for what you already finished, and brings it back to Continue showing which one it is. It queries extensions in the background; turn it off to save data.
settings.auto-check-update-off-body:
PrismHub will stop telling you when a new version is out.

Important fixes will not reach you, and extensions may stop working when sites change, with no explanation. You will have to check by hand from here.

You can turn it back on whenever you want.

beta.title: PrismHub is in beta
beta.intro: Thanks for trying PrismHub. This version is still in development, so it is normal to run into a few rough edges.
beta.point-bugs: If you hit a bug, a screen that looks off or something that does not respond as expected, report it with the button below. Ideas and suggestions are just as welcome: it is the fastest way for the app to grow.
beta.point-extensions: Content comes from third-party extensions. If a site changes or goes down, that extension may stop working until it is updated.
beta.point-updates: Issues are fixed in later versions. Keeping the app and your extensions up to date is recommended.
beta.point-thanks: Nothing you save (history, favorites, settings) is lost between versions.
beta.legal: PrismHub does not host or distribute content: it only shows what third-party extensions return from public sites. You are responsible for how you use it and for complying with your local laws. The full legal notice is in Settings.
beta.point-author: Litdemonick, the project creator, keeps working on PrismHub: fixing bugs, polishing what is there and adding new features with every release.
beta.point-ext-updates: Extensions update on their own, from Installed extensions: when one is fixed or improved you update it right there, with no need to wait for or install a new version of PrismHub.
beta.ads-body:
In this version, ads may show up while using some extensions. PrismHub has no ads of its own and earns nothing from them.

They can be skipped or closed, they do not cover the player, and they do not affect the app or your device: they are just a momentary nuisance.

An ad blocker for extensions is coming in future versions. It will be possible to turn off, because blocking too much sometimes stops the video from loading in the browser player — if ads do not bother you, leaving it off is the better choice.
beta.point-design: The design is still being polished and will change across versions. It is being adapted to every kind of screen — desktop, phone, tablet, TV — so it looks and works well on all of them.
beta.point-wip: You will come across options that do nothing yet or feel half-finished. They are not broken: they are features under construction, already identified, that will be completed in upcoming versions. If one of them does not respond, do not worry.
beta.repo-body:
Every extension comes from prism-plus, the official and only PrismHub repository. That is what guarantees whatever you install has been reviewed and signed.

The catalog is growing: many more will be added over time, for every kind of content, and the ones already there get fixed and improved on their own. Remember they update from Installed extensions, without waiting for a new app version.
beta.repo-count: Right now there are {count} extensions available, covering streaming, series, movies, anime, manga and novels. Most of what people look for is already covered, but prism-plus keeps growing: if something is missing, chances are it will be added later on.
beta.point-settings:
Take a look around Settings: almost everything in the app is configured there. Language, theme, +18 Zone access and its PIN, the player and its skip intervals, network and logs. And at the bottom, under "About", you will find the app info and version, the legal notice, the link to report bugs or suggest improvements, and the project and extension repositories.

That section is being polished too: some options do nothing yet and others are locked on purpose, because changing them today would leave the app unusable. They will be enabled as they become ready.
beta.point-linux: The Linux build is the least tested of the three: something may fail to start or behave differently than on Windows and Android. That is not intentional and will be fixed in upcoming versions. If you run into anything, report it and mention your distribution: it helps a lot.
beta.confirm-body:
This notice will not be shown again. It explains important things about how the app works: ads from extensions, features still under construction, how extensions update, and the legal notice.

Reading it before continuing is recommended. If you already did, carry on.
